description: Get Fit: Proper Pull-Up Technique, MCAS Iwakuni, 2026, B-roll
rights_basis: Wikimedia Commons records PD-US-Marines: official-duty U.S. federal government work, public domain in the United States.
credit: U.S. Marine Corps / AFN Iwakuni; original video credited to Andrew Knight and Saul Hernandez.
use: Test-only decoder/pose smoke fixture and end-to-end movement-only workout demo regression. No endorsement, no medical or form ground truth, no commercial marketing use.

visual_review.method: Complete-source contact sheet and all 40 selected frames inspected before model inference. Single-reviewer observation, not adjudicated ground truth.
visual_review.observed_content: One athlete in a continuous rear/oblique view: hang, ascent, peak, descent and return to hang. One visually observed movement cycle.
limitations: Head/chin cropped around the peak; strict top criterion is ungradable.
Hands and apparatus are close to the top image boundary.
No anatomical joint labels or qualified rep-validity labels.
visual_review.replaces: Original 0-4 second interval showed two people introducing the exercise, not repetitions.

demo_expectation.scope: Production video reader + Apple Vision + reviewed fixed bar reference + production movement counter + completed result data. This is a regression/demo expectation, not rep-validity or form ground truth.
demo_expectation.bar_reference_note: Manually reviewed visible gripping-bar edge in the 640x360 prepared frame. Fixed camera; reference is reused for the full clip.
limitations: Movement-only expectation under the current bar-relative policy; chin clearance is not measured.
The fixture is one athlete/view and is not an accuracy benchmark.
The reference edge is fixture-specific reviewed test data, not automatic semantic bar recognition.
